records.jp: ……愛央、もう寝た？
records.en_original: Ao... Are you asleep?
records.en_auxiliary: Ao... Are you asleep?
records.en: Ao... Are you asleep?

records.jp: 寝た
records.en_original: Yep.
records.en_auxiliary: Yep.
records.en: Yep.

records.jp: じゃあ起きて
records.en_original: Then wake up.
records.en_auxiliary: Then wake up.
records.en: Then wake up.

records.jp: 仕方ないなあ
records.en_original: Fiiiine.
records.en_auxiliary: Fiiiine.
records.en: Fiiiine.

records.jp: 寝てない
records.en_original: Nope.
records.en_auxiliary: Nope.
records.en: Nope.

records.jp: だと思った。あたしも寝れなかったとこ
records.en_original: Thought so. I can't sleep either.
records.en_auxiliary: Thought so. I can't sleep either.
records.en: Thought so. I can't sleep either.

records.jp: …………狭いね
records.en_original: ...It's a bit tight, huh?
records.en_auxiliary: ...It's a bit tight, huh?
records.en: ...It's a bit tight, huh?

records.jp: もっと詰めてよ、勇希
records.en_original: Come closer, Yuki.
records.en_auxiliary: Come closer, Yuki.
records.en: Scoot over a little more, Yuki.

records.jp: これ以上無理だよ。密着するしかない
records.en_original: I can't get any closer without touching you. Guess I'll just have to cuddle you.
records.en_auxiliary: I can't get any closer without touching you. Guess I'll just have to cuddle you.
records.en: I cannot move any farther. We would have to press right against each other.

records.jp: 私はそれでもいいよ？
records.en_original: I don't mind.
records.en_auxiliary: I don't mind.
records.en: I don't mind.

records.jp: え、あ、いや、言ってみただけだし！<CR>恥ずかしいから、やっぱナシで……
records.en_original: U-uh, I was—I was just messing around! Aaah, now I'm all embarrassed, I take it back...
records.en_auxiliary: U-uh, I was—I was just messing around! Aaah, now I'm all embarrassed, I take it back...
records.en: U-uh, I was—I was just messing around! Aaah,<CR>now I'm all embarrassed, I take it back...

records.jp: え、それはちょっと、恥ずかしいんだけど……
records.en_original: O-oh, that might be a little awkward...
records.en_auxiliary: O-oh, that might be a little awkward...
records.en: O-oh, that might be a little awkward...

records.jp: なになに～？　いいじゃん、女の子同士なんだから！
records.en_original: No way! We're both girls, so it's fine, right?
records.en_auxiliary: No way! We're both girls, so it's fine, right?
records.en: No way! We're both girls, so it's fine, right?

records.jp: む、無理！　この距離、キープで！
records.en_original: N-no, it's not fine! Stop right there!
records.en_auxiliary: N-no, it's not fine! Stop right there!
records.en: N-no, it's not fine! Stop right there!

records.jp: いつもとは違う天井。<CR>いつもとは違う空気……
records.en_original: A different ceiling from normal... Different air from normal...
records.en_auxiliary: A different ceiling from normal... Different air from normal...
records.en: A different ceiling from normal...<CR>Different air from normal...

records.jp: あと、隣に愛央
records.en_original: And an Ao by my side.
records.en_auxiliary: And an Ao by my side.
records.en: And an Ao by my side.

records.jp: なんか、いいよね。こういうの。<CR>普段とは違う場所で寝るってだけなのに
records.en_original: You know, this is nice. And all I did was sleep somewhere different.
records.en_auxiliary: You know, this is nice. And all I did was sleep somewhere different.
records.en: There is something nice about this.<CR>Even though we are only sleeping somewhere different from usual.

records.jp: うん。特別な感じがする
records.en_original: Yeah. It feels kinda special.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah. It feels kinda special.
records.en: Yeah. It feels kinda special.

records.jp: 愛央はキャンプとか、したことある？
records.en_original: Have you ever gone camping, Ao?
records.en_auxiliary: Have you ever gone camping, Ao?
records.en: Have you ever gone camping, Ao?

records.jp: ちょっとだけあるよ。<CR>家族で旅行に行ったときとか
records.en_original: Yeah, a few times. With my family.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah, a few times. With my family.
records.en: Yeah, a few times.<CR>With my family.

records.jp: へー、けっこうアウトドアなんだ？
records.en_original: Ooh, really? Are you the outdoorsy type, then?
records.en_auxiliary: Ooh, really? Are you the outdoorsy type, then?
records.en: Ooh, really? Are you the outdoorsy type, then?

records.jp: 私、というより家族がね
records.en_original: Not so much, but my family is.
records.en_auxiliary: Not so much, but my family is.
records.en: Not so much, but my family is.

records.jp: あんまりないかなー。<CR>林間学校でやったくらい？
records.en_original: Not really. Well, unless you count summer camp.
records.en_auxiliary: Not really. Well, unless you count summer camp.
records.en: Not very much.<CR>Only on a school camping trip, perhaps?

records.jp: 普通そうだよね。<CR>なかなか気軽にやれることじゃないし
records.en_original: Yeah, makes sense. It's not the kind of thing you can do whenever you want.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah, makes sense. It's not the kind of thing you can do whenever you want.
records.en: Yeah, makes sense. It's<CR>not the kind of thing you can do whenever you want.

records.jp: でも、だからこそ特別だって感じられるのかも？
records.en_original: Maybe that's what makes it feel extra special.
records.en_auxiliary: Maybe that's what makes it feel extra special.
records.en: Maybe that's what makes it feel extra special.

records.jp: だからこそって？
records.en_original: What do you mean?
records.en_auxiliary: What do you mean?
records.en: What do you mean?

records.jp: あんまりこういうのって、<CR>自分からやろうとはならないじゃん？
records.en_original: Well, this kind of thing doesn't just happen on its own.
records.en_auxiliary: Well, this kind of thing doesn't just happen on its own.
records.en: You do not usually decide on your own<CR>to do something like this, right?

records.jp: だから、自分から興味を持って<CR>こういうことしてみるのも、たまにはいいかもなーって
records.en_original: You have to choose to do it, you know? So I thought that makes it feel special.
records.en_auxiliary: You have to choose to do it, you know? So I thought that makes it feel special.
records.en: So I thought it might be nice, once in a while,<CR>to take an interest and try something like this ourselves.

records.jp: ……ふふっ。たしかに
records.en_original: Hehe. That's true.
records.en_auxiliary: Hehe. That's true.
records.en: Hehe. That's true.

records.jp: ……勇希、今日は付き合ってくれてありがと
records.en_original: Yuki... Thanks for hanging out with me today.
records.en_auxiliary: Yuki... Thanks for hanging out with me today.
records.en: Yuki... Thanks for hanging out with me today.

records.jp: ううん。あたしも楽しかった
records.en_original: You don't have to thank me. I had fun, too.
records.en_auxiliary: You don't have to thank me. I had fun, too.
records.en: You don't have to thank me. I had fun, too.
